name: Raja Chakraborty

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Raja Chakraborty grew up in Kolkata and writes in Bengali and English. He studied English literature at Calcutta University and also sketches and paints. His Bengali writing includes humorous and satirical rhymes, while his English collections include Whispers in the Wind and 65 Ways to Talk and Forget.

In “Crack”, a thin mark spreading across a wall becomes an image of two people drifting apart. Paint cannot hide old wounds, and remembered laughter cannot repair the fracture. The short lines allow an ordinary surface to carry the weight of an unspoken relationship.
